sections.context: Dave wants a Pi-native skill that preserves the strongest parts of Matt Pocock's improve-codebase-architecture flow while replacing grill-with-docs as the workflow owner. The new package should live at ~/tools/pi-skills, be discoverable by Pi as a skills package, and make Seeds the canonical execution state for architecture improvement work: candidate report, structured decision checkpoints, candidate-specific Seeds epic/plan/tasks, validation, PR-first closeout, and post-outcome Mulch only when justified.
sections.approach: Create one integrated skill named seeds-architecture-review inside a local Pi package. Keep the architecture deepening vocabulary and visual HTML candidate-report pattern, but inline or bundle all required guidance so there are no broken links back to the source repository. The skill will instruct agents to inspect Seeds first, load CONTEXT.md/CONTEXT-MAP.md and ADRs when present, produce a temporary HTML report for exploration, use ask_user only for durable branch points with normal-chat fallback, create or update a candidate-specific Seeds epic, run a Seeds-backed design interrogation, compare interface alternatives, submit a Seeds plan with child tasks only after design decisions crystallise, and require validation/review/PR-first closeout. This is preferred over multiple smaller skills because the workflow has one coherent lifecycle and should keep Seeds as the source of truth end to end.

alternatives.name: Use grill-with-docs directly
alternatives.rejected_because: It makes the grilling loop the workflow owner and does not align with Dave's Seeds-first execution model. We only want to reuse its discipline around questions, glossary updates, and sparse ADRs.

alternatives.name: Create three composable skills
alternatives.rejected_because: Splitting architecture review, interrogation, and interface design would make handoffs easier to forget and would weaken the requirement that Seeds stays canonical across the whole lifecycle.

alternatives.name: Generate only documentation without Seeds
alternatives.rejected_because: The skill is specifically intended to produce governed, trackable work. Without Seeds plans and child issues, the HTML report would become the durable state by accident.

steps.title: Bootstrap Pi package skeleton
steps.description: Create the local package layout with package.json, README.md, AGENTS.md, and skills/engineering/seeds-architecture-review/SKILL.md. Include package metadata with version, private true, pi-package keyword, and pi.skills pointing at ./skills.

steps.title: Implement skill content and bundled references
steps.description: Write a self-contained SKILL.md with valid frontmatter, architecture vocabulary, report expectations, Seeds-first startup, CONTEXT.md and ADR rules, interface alternative comparison, and no broken references to grill-with-docs or Matt's repository.

steps.title: Design Seeds-native workflow
steps.description: Make the skill lifecycle explicit: report -> candidate selection -> candidate-specific Seeds epic -> design interrogation -> interface alternatives -> Seeds plan -> child tasks -> implementation/review/PR -> Seeds outcome/Mulch. Define when to create versus update existing Seeds issues and plans.

steps.title: Define ask_user checkpoint pattern
steps.description: Document ask_user as optional. Use it only for durable branch points: candidate selection, seam placement, interface selection with previews, scope selection, ADR confirmation, and Seeds plan approval. Include normal-chat fallback when the tool is unavailable.

steps.title: Document install and usage
steps.description: Write README usage for local installation with pi install /Users/dave/tools/pi-skills, loading /skill:seeds-architecture-review, expected target-repo mutations, compatibility expectations, and how to run a dry review without implementation.

steps.title: Validate Pi compatibility
steps.description: Verify package.json parses, skill frontmatter has valid name/description/compatibility, the description is under 1024 characters, no required links are broken, and the package uses Pi skill discovery conventions.

steps.title: Review workflow quality with dry run
steps.description: Perform a read-only review of the created skill as if applying it to a real repository. Confirm Seeds is canonical, ask_user is checkpoint-only, CONTEXT.md remains glossary-only, ADRs are sparse, Mulch is post-outcome, and PR-first closeout is explicit.

risks: The skill could become a lightly ported copy with stale or broken relative links instead of a self-contained Pi skill.
ask_user could be overused for every clarifying question, making the interrogation loop noisy and rigid.
The temporary HTML report could accidentally become the durable source of truth instead of Seeds.
CONTEXT.md and ADRs could be mutated too eagerly during exploration rather than after decisions crystallise.
PR-first closeout could remain implicit and be skipped by agents executing the skill later.
acceptance: ~/tools/pi-skills is a Seeds project with the parent epic and child implementation issues created from this plan.
The package has package.json with version, private true, pi-package keyword, and pi.skills set to ./skills.
The skill exists at skills/engineering/seeds-architecture-review/SKILL.md with valid frontmatter name seeds-architecture-review and a specific description under 1024 characters.
The skill is self-contained: no broken references to grill-with-docs, Matt's repository, or missing local support docs.

The workflow explicitly includes Seeds-first inspection, temporary HTML candidate report, optional ask_user checkpoints with fallback, Seeds-backed design interrogation, interface alternative comparison, Seeds child issue creation, validation/review, PR-first closeout, and post-outcome Mulch only after success.
README.md documents local Pi installation and /skill:seeds-architecture-review usage.
Validation confirms JSON parses and no Markdown links in the skill point to missing local files.

name: Seeds-native architecture review skill
outcomeNote: Implemented the local Pi skills package and self-contained seeds-architecture-review skill. package.json parses, Markdown links resolve, frontmatter checks pass, and oracle review found no blocking findings.
